instrument: Municipal curative amendment and 180-day pause on data center applications (June 8, 2026)
summary: Supervisors unanimously declared parts of the zoning ordinance invalid for not addressing data centers, triggering a 180-day period to draft a curative amendment for data centers and accessory uses, during which no one else may challenge the ordinance.

source.citation: Times Leader; Fox 56; Center Square; Food & Water Watch; Penn Capital-Star (Nov 2025-Sept 2026)

confidence_note: Resolution not read; expiry (about early December 2026) is derived, not stated.
